text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower was downcast after Mihono 
Bourbon's injury. However, running 
alongside Matikanetannhauser reminds her 
of the joy of racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower resumed training to become 
stronger by the time Mihono Bourbon 
returned, growing by leaps and bounds—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon, who had also been feeling 
down due to her injury, drew courage from 
Rice Shower's running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From that conversation, Machikane 
Tannhauser realizes that Rice Shower is 
the "protagonist" who gave strength to 
Mihono Bourbon's heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The way she kept repeating the word 
'protagonist' over and over, savoring it 
deeply... left a lasting impression.
